results.summary: The director keeps a Gold balance that starts at 0. It shows "Gold: N" in the HUD status lines, spawns a gold purse at the barracks node, and gives 100 gold once on E. The purse is destroyed and a bPurseTaken guard stops a second pickup. Not built or played here, so the runtime behaviour is unverified.

evidence.note: Spawned in the director's floor-build code at NodeLocation("barracks"). The barracks node exists in floor1_map.json.
HandleInteract adds PurseGold (100) once, guarded by bPurseTaken. It then destroys the purse. The header comments mark 100 as a demo value.
GetStatusLines adds the gold line. DDDemoHUD draws the status lines from Director->GetStatusLines().
E is bound to Interact. The nearest focused interactable receives it, so the purse is reachable.

results.score_reason: Gold feeds paying the toll (GDD line 319), so DD-TOLL-02 and DD-DESC-01 depend on it. It is already in code, so building it now matters little beyond checking it in play.

results.summary: A bandit boss interactable is spawned at boss_room. LoadBanditData reads bandit_strings.csv and faction_stages.json (threatening toll_gold = 100). Pressing E on the boss shows bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01 with {toll_amount} filled in, plus a "Press Q ... to pay" line. {adventurer_name} is filled with the generic word "adventurer" because the demo has no player name. The data files in the plugin's Content/Data directory were not diffed against inputs/crew_encounter/. The game was not run.

evidence.note: Spawned at NodeLocation("boss_room") after LoadBanditData(). The boss_room node exists in the map.
The E branch of case EDDDemoKind::Boss in HandleInteract shows this string via BossLine. A second message gives the Q pay hint with the toll amount.
Parses the CSV and picks toll_gold from the "threatening" stage. BossLine replaces {toll_amount} and {adventurer_name}.
The source string exists. A matching copy is in Plugins/DelveDeeperContent/Content/Data, which ReadDataFile reads. That copy was not diffed.

results.score_reason: The boss's toll demand is the core of the Boss and standing section (GDD lines 385-387), and DD-TOLL-02 builds on it. It is already in code and reached by E.

results.summary: Q on the boss pays the toll. With gold >= toll it subtracts exactly TollGold, sets bTollPaid and shows bandit_boss_toll_paid_01. With less gold it shows bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 and changes nothing. Once bTollPaid is set, Q only says the player already paid, so there is no second charge. No faction favor is touched. Not run in this review.

evidence.note: The bAlt branch of case EDDDemoKind::Boss checks bTollPaid first, then Gold >= TollGold, then deducts and sets bTollPaid. The else branch shows the cannot-pay line with no deduction.
Q is bound to AltInteract, which calls Interact(true). DDDemoInteractable::Interact then calls Director->HandleInteract.
The cannot-pay string is shown from the same handler. PromptFor shows the Q pay prompt.

results.score_reason: Paying is the milestone's central mechanic (GDD lines 385-390), and the descent depends on bTollPaid. It is already in code, so only play-testing is left.

results.summary: A descent interactable is spawned at node descent. Before the toll is paid, E shows "The bandit boss bars the way down" and the demo continues. After payment, E sets bDemoOver, adds a win message and disables pawn input. The HUD draws a persistent YOU WIN banner while IsDemoOver() is true. Not built or run here, so the visual result is unverified.

evidence.note: Spawned at NodeLocation("descent"). The descent node exists in floor1_map.json.
case EDDDemoKind::Descent in HandleInteract. If !bTollPaid it only adds the barred message. Otherwise it sets bDemoOver, adds the win message and calls Pawn->DisableInput.

evidence.symbol: YOU WIN - You went down the descent
evidence.note: The banner is drawn while Director->IsDemoOver(), so it stays up.

results.score_reason: The win is the milestone's end state (GDD lines 44-45 and 390). It is already in code, depends on DD-TOLL-02, and nothing else waits on it.
